instances.overview: This XGBoost model predicts binary customer churn (Yes/No) using demographic, service subscription, and billing features from a telecommunications dataset of 7,043 customers. It is designed to identify at-risk customers for proactive retention campaigns. The model handles class imbalance via ROC-AUC optimization and provides feature importance for business interpretability.
instances.usage:
